about: Generic, explainable ordering and conservative local grouping for overlap pairs. Scores order review; they are not probabilities and never suppress a pair.
incidentRadiusQuantity: maximum diagonal of an incident's combined world-space contact-support boxes, in Skyrim units; complete contact envelopes are preferred, otherwise the intersection of measured placed-NIF world bounds; unknown or individually larger supports are singleton

limits: Ranking is an explainable review order, not a consequence probability.
